items.title: Manuel Mello Interview, 1959-08-03
items.q: Mark McCurt sitting on the side of me. He'd be laughing or just Long Sonata, guitar and the string bass player that kept the music, kept the melody out.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the tunes your father played on the harmonica?

Oh, yeah. All them old tunes. Swanee River. And I only just wanted to know. Widow done. Six Little Angels. Boy, we're going back now. We're going back now. We used to play that Long Sonata. Oh, yeah? Yeah, Long Sonata used to, because you see, he knew it. And I knew it. And when we played, we had with Jack Lane, Jack Lane to make all kind of four faces. Man, he'd be making faces a day, you know, and Mark McCurt sitting on the side of me. He'd be laughing or just Long Sonata, guitar and the string bass player that…
How many brothers did you have? Three. Did they all play music?
